title: Profiles
description: A profile remembers which components are installed and how they are set up. Applying one installs the components through the install wizard and brings their settings back. Profiles are shared with the in-game mod window.
name: Name
emptyHint: Save the current components and settings to come back to them in one click.
deleteDescription: The installed components and the current in-game settings stay as they are.

validation.name: Enter a name up to 40 characters
validation.code: A code starts with TM1. or TS1.

fromLink: The profile code from the link is filled in — check it and import
components: {count, plural, one {# component} other {# components}} and settings
saveDescription: The components turned on now and their settings from the mod window.
presetsDescription: Opens the install wizard with the set; once installed, save it as your own profile.
importDescription: A TM1.… profile code, an old TS1.… build code or a .tmset / .json file with old builds.
applyWithInstallHint: The components differ: the install opens first, then the settings are applied
pendingSetsTitle: {count, plural, one {# old build is} other {# old builds are}} waiting for room
pendingSetsHint: Builds are profiles now. There can be at most 12 profiles: delete the ones you do not need and the remaining builds move in on their own.
